children: fell on Thursday after the Cambridge, Massachusetts-based biotech indicated a delayed timeline for releasing early-stage trial data for its bispecific T cell engager CLN-978 in rheumatoid arthritis.
The company now expects multi-dose regimen data from a Phase 1 trial for CLN-978 in difficult-to-treat rheumatoid arthritis in December compared with a Q3 timeline suggested with its second-quarter

The readout will be combined with Phase 1 data for the drug in two other autoimmune conditions, systemic lupus erythematosus and Sjögren’s disease. The updated timeline was disclosed on Thursday in a release outlining the company’s 2026 milestones across its immunology
However, Wedbush analyst Robert Driscoll, who has an Outperform rating on Cullinan
, remains bullish on the company, noting, “We view the shift into a combined, later December readout constructively.”
It “will allow for more mature, longer-follow-up data on the multi-dose regimen in SLE specifically, alongside the newly added SjD expansion,” Driscoll added, according to Bloomberg.

title: Cullinan drops after delaying early-stage trial data for arthritis therapy
